request.style: English, Indian Christian bhajan, harmonium and tanpura drone, tabla, flute, a female lead answered by a group, slow devotional opening gradually speeding up, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I am the vine, you are the branches
Abide in me, and I in you
Whoever abides in me bears much fruit
For apart from me you can do nothing

[Chorus]
Abide in me, abide in me
Abide in my love
Abide in me, abide in me
Abide in my love

[Verse]
As the Father has loved me
So have I loved you
By this my Father is glorified
That you bear much fruit

[Chorus]
Abide in me, abide in me
Abide in my love
Abide in me, abide in me
Abide in my love
